Q / W Cannons (fast, unlimited)
A / S Chain Shot (slows enemy)

HOW TO PLAY
Position your ship broadside to the enemy and unleash your cannons. Sink enemy ships to advance waves and choose upgrades. Each side reloads independently — fire port, then swing around and fire starboard!
Also: Mouse click (LMB port / RMB star) • Space auto-aims • Touch supported
